g.text: All nodes and relations describe target assembly.
Hosts own persistence, output and close policy.
Model tools = framework profile + direct Agent adapters [P].
Skill loading never registers its business tools [P].
Commands use their own HTTP boundary and never enter the model list.
Skill resources disclose one business definition at a time [P].
CallTool uses Skill bindings; adapters use direct Agent bindings [P].
Runtime: eleven framework tools plus direct Agent adapters [P].
Cron and Child exclude the three interaction tools.
[P] nodes and blue relations = Pending implementation.
Interaction tools are implemented at Java 8c5fda1d; details in the Plan Mode topic.
